title: Cyathula prostrata herpes-zoster chemotype study: analysis code and processed data
description: Analysis and figure-generation code together with the processed data required to reproduce every main and supplementary figure and the supplementary tables of the manuscript "Metabolomic and computational dissection of Cyathula prostrata identifies a sesquiterpene-flavonoid-coumarin chemotype predicted to engage the TNF/NF-kB axis of herpes zoster, with in-vitro TNF-alpha validation." Includes: untargeted-metabolomics processed feature/annotation tables, PLS-DA/volcano/heatmap and network-pharmacology (PPI, GO/KEGG) inputs, machine-learning and molecular-docking result tables, MD analysis curves (GROMACS .xvg) and run parameters (.mdp), and processed in-vitro (CCK-8/ELISA) results. Raw UHPLC-HRMS data are deposited separately in MetaboLights; full MD trajectories in a separate Zenodo record.
